questions.q: In the knee joint, articular cartilage lies on the:

opts: Degeneration of articular cartilage → raw bone surfaces rub against each other
questions.exp: Pathogenesis: degeneration of articular cartilage → raw bone surfaces rub against each other. (Book p191)

questions.q: When raw bone surfaces rub against each other in OA:
questions.exp: Raw bone surfaces rub → pain, ↑ sclerosis (density) of bone. (Book p191)

questions.q: Necrosis/cysts in the bone in OA are d/t:
questions.exp: Necrosis/cysts in the bone (d/t ↓ vascularity). (Book p191)

questions.q: Regeneration of bone in OA forms:
questions.exp: Regeneration of bone → forms osteophytes. (Book p191)

questions.q: Osteophytes breaking off in OA form:
opts: Loose bodies (move freely in the joint)
questions.exp: Osteophytes break off → form loose bodies (move freely in the joint). (Book p191)

questions.q: Clinical feature of osteoarthritis is:
questions.exp: Clinical features: pain on active & passive movement. (Book p191)

opts: ↓ muscle usage → muscle atrophy (m/c: vastus medialis of quadriceps)
questions.exp: ↓ ROM → ↓ muscle usage → muscle atrophy (m/c: vastus medialis of quadriceps). (Book p191)

questions.q: Clinical feature of osteoarthritis is:

questions.q: Bouchard's node is swelling at the:

opts: Most of the weight bearing occurs on the medial side
questions.exp: Most of the weight bearing is on the medial side → joint space decreases medially first → genu varum. (Book p192)

questions.exp: Osteoarthritis is the m/c cause of b/l genu varum. (Book p192)

questions.exp: Loose bodies in knee: m/c cause osteoarthritis. (Book p192)

questions.exp: m/c cause in elderly: osteoarthritis. (Book p192)

questions.exp: Medication (supportive): NSAID's - acetaminophen. (Book p192)

questions.exp: TKR complication: patellar clunk syndrome. (Book p192)

opts: Femoral component replacement + tibial component replacement
questions.exp: TKR: femoral component replacement and tibial component replacement. (Book p192)
